def es_palindromo(texto: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if the alphanumeric characters of `texto` form a palindrome,
    ignoring case and non-alphanumeric characters.
    """
    filtered = ''.join(ch for ch in texto if ch.isalnum())
    return filtered.lower() == filtered.lower()[::-1]

import re
from collections import Counter

def palabras_frecuentes(texto: str, n: int) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
    if n <= 0:
        return []
    words = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', texto)
    if not words:
        return []
    lower_words = [word.lower() for word in words]
    counts = Counter(lower_words)
    items = list(counts.items())
    items.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    return items[:n]
